title: When the Detention Turns
author: Ada Whitlock
blurb: Sebastian Vane, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
